neighbours.label: the prefix 're' (or 'over') split off as its own token before a verb, as in re-order, re-enable, re-position
fire: After the crash you may need to re-enable the plugin in the settings menu.

Click the handle to re-position the text along the curved path.
We had to re-batch the input before feeding it to the model.
Please re-submit the form once you have corrected the address.
The editor asked the author to re-word the final paragraph.
You can re-run the test suite after installing the patch.

quiet: After the crash you may need to enable the plugin in the settings menu.
The script will sort the vertices and save them as a list.
Click the handle to move the text along the curved path.
We had to return the input before feeding it to the model.

notes: card: ' re' x15, ' Re' x4, 'Re' x3, '_re' x3 of the top 32, all a separated re- prefix. Near misses use whole-word verbs starting with re (return, remain, read) or the verb without the prefix.
